questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Torque r×F। z-component rx Fy−ry Fx=(8)·2−1·0=2×(8); dot product নয়।

questions.question_bn: Wavelength 3 m। একই সময়ে separation 3/4 m-এর phase difference কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Spatial phase difference Δφ=2πΔx/λ=2π·¼=π/2; time fixed বলে শুধু spatial term।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Common-emitter switch: emitter grounded, VCC=12 V, RC=1kΩ, β=50, IB=90μA। saturation-এ VCE=0.2 V। active/saturation দুটো অবস্থা বিবেচনা করে collector current কত mA?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Active prediction Ic=βIb=0.5×(9) mA। Load সীমা Ic=(12−0.2)/1000=11.8mA। prediction এই সীমা ছাড়ালে transistor saturated; ছোট মানটি নিতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: Speed v=L/t। L=(4±0.01)m,t=(2±0.02)s। first-ordermaxfractionaluncertainty কোনটি?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Fractionaluncertaintyquotient-এ magnitudesadd:δv/v≤δL/L+δt/t=0.01/(4)+0.02/2। sameunitfractions দরকার।

questions.question_bn: Circular coil radius RcentreB₀। same coil on axis distance√3R,B/B₀ কত? current 7A
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। OnaxisB/B₀=R³/(R²+x²)^(3/2)=(1+3)^(-3/2)=1/8। current cancels ratio।

questions.question_bn: Star radius R→3R ও temperature T→2T। luminosity factor কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। L=4πR²σT⁴। radius contributes (3)², temperature 16; factor 16×(3)²।

questions.question_bn: F(x)=2x N, mass 5 kg rest থেকে x=0→3 m। final speed² কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Work ∫₀³2x dx=9 J。 work-energy ½mv²=9⇒v²=18/(5)।

questions.question_bn: F=(5,2,0) N, displacement=(1,−5,0) m। work কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Dot product F·s=(5)−2×(5)=−(5)। বলের বিপরীত projected displacement negative work দেয়।

questions.question_bn: Pump input 400 W, efficiency 60%; height 10 m, g=10। water flow mass rate কত kg/s?

questions.question_bn: Particle charge 7 C uniform static B-এ moves, electric field নেই। magnetic force-এর কাজ কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Magnetic force qv×B always perpendicular to velocity। P=F·v=0; speed/kinetic energy অপরিবর্তিত।

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=14 mol,H₂=28 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(14))/3,availableN₂(14) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(14)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।

questions.question_bn: Ideal gas P2atm,V=36.900000000000006L,T300 K,R0.082। amount কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। (3)=PV/(RT)=2·12.3×(3)/(0.082·300)=24.6×(3)/24.6=(3) mol; no extra Avogadro multiplication।

questions.question_bn: প্রতি molecule-এ 9 টি independent C≡C, অন্য unsaturation নেই।1 mol sample fully hydrogenate করতে H₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। প্রতি triple bond-এ twoπbonds; alkane পর্যন্ত saturation-এর জন্য 2H₂। মোট 2×(9) mol, semihydrogenation-এ(9)।

questions.question_bn: 2H₂+O₂→2H₂O। H₂=45 mol,O₂=15 mol। remainingH₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। O₂limitingn moluses 2nH₂। initial 3×(15) minusconsumed 2×(15) leavesn mol; product 2×(15) আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Water[Ca²⁺]=15mmol/L, no Mg। CaCO₃ equivalent hardness কত mg/L? MCaCO₃100g/mol
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Ca²⁺-এর 1mmol equivalent 1mmol CaCO₃।100g/mol⇒100mg/mmol; hardness 100nmg/L।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas A molar mass 196, B mass 784 g/mol। equalT-তে diffusion rA/rB কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Graham r∝1/√M। ratio√(MB/MA)=√4=2, inverse mass ratio 4 নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 12 mol triglyceride complete NaOH saponification-এ NaOH কত mol লাগে?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। প্রতি triglyceride-এ 3ester linkage। each 1 mol NaOH hydrolyses; total 3×(12) mol, glycerol ও উৎপন্ন।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: HaberprocessN₂input 16 mol,H₂excess,singlepassN₂conversion 25%। NH₃out কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। ReactedN₂=(16)/4 mol。 N₂→2NH₃mole factor 2⇒NH₃(16)/2 mol; unreactedN₂recyclingwouldadditionalpasses।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food oil iodometry-তে I₂ 26mmol মুক্ত। I₂+2S₂O₃²⁻→2I⁻+S₄O₆²⁻। thiosulfate কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 26। Reaction coefficients iodine 1 ও thiosulfate 2। তাই nmmol iodine fully titrate করতে 2nmmol thiosulfate।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Metalfeed 180 kg,smeltingyield 80%,purification recovery 90%। final metal কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Sequential recovery multiply 0.8×0.9=0.72।10nkgfeed→7.2nkg; percentageyieldsadd নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 44mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 11mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। HClconsumed=4×(11)−(11)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 150g,dry mass 120g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(15)/(10×(15))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=5×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((5)×10⁻²)=(1/(5))×10⁻⁸M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 2SO₂+O₂→2SO₃। SO₂amount 29molfullyconvert। oxygen needed কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 29। CoefficientratioO₂:SO₂=1:2। needn/2molO₂; oxygen atom count molecular count distinct ion।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 15mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। MnO₄⁻acidic Mn²⁺-এ 5electronaccepts। each Fe²⁺oneelectronloses⇒5Fe²⁺perpermanganate।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=81×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((9)²×10⁻⁹)=(9)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: MX₂(s)⇌M²⁺+2X⁻। pure-water molar solubility s=21×10⁻⁴M। Ksp কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। Ion concentrations s,2s। Ksp=s(2s)²=4s³=4×(21)³×10⁻¹²; stoichiometric coefficient squared।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Al³⁺+3e⁻→Al; charge 15F,100%efficiency,MAl27। aluminium কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Three electron per mole Al⇒(15)/3 mol Al। mass 27·(15)/3=9ng, oxidation state dependent।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 10 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 5 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Initial H⁺0.2×(5) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(5) mmol; excess 0.1×(5) mmol,total 3×(5) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Acyclic saturated hydrocarbon carbon count 12, C12,H1। molar mass কত g/mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Alkane formulaCₙH₂ₙ₊₂। molar mass 12×(12)+2×(12)+2=14×(12)+2; alkene mass 14×(12) আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: ConductanceG=10S,cellconstantl/A=2 cm⁻¹। conductivityκ কত S/cm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। κ=G(l/A)=2nS/cm। resistance reciprocalalreadyinconductance; cellconstantnotinverse।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 32×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 32। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (32)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((32)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas volume 16L at300 K,1atm। final 600 K,4atm। final volume কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Fixed gas amount combined law V₂/V₁=(T₂/T₁)(P₁/P₂)=2·¼=½। Celsius ব্যবহার নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=22M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(22)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((22)−1), initial concentration নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=12D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=20, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।

questions.question_bn: Acyclic alkane C20H42 complete combustion-এ 1 mol fuel-এর O₂ requirement কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। CₙH₂ₙ₊₂→nCO₂+((20)+1)H₂O। oxygen atoms 3×(20)+1⇒O₂=(3×(20)+1)/2 mol; water oxygen ও ধরতে হয়।

questions.question_bn: 2700g brine 10%w/w Na Cl। solvent water mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 27। 10%w/w means 100g solution-এ 10g Na Cl। salt 10×(27) g; remaining water 90×(27) g।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Arrhenius equation-এ Ea/R=14000 K। T₁=300 K,T₂=600 K। ln(k₂/k₁) কত?

questions.question_bn: Mono alkene C17H34 completely burn।1 mol hydrocarbon থেকে CO₂:H₂O mole ratio কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Products nCO₂+nH₂O; carbon (17) ও hydrogen 2×(17) balanced। mole ratio 1:1, oxygen consumption 3×(17)/2 আলাদা।
